active_slice.missing_deliverable: Phase 9.3 has no bounded audio direction or dynamic-range policy specifying cue hierarchy, quiet investigation, ambience/music roles and accessible independent controls.
active_slice.instructions: Read the settled game direction and existing audio constraints, then write one concrete Phase 9.3 policy covering sonic palette, foreground/background cue hierarchy, meaningful off-screen cues, restrained music, provisional loudness/headroom and ducking targets, future voice coexistence, accessibility and the required independent buses/controls. Keep numerical targets explicitly provisional until measured against real audio. Identify asset classes and a finite later audition/implementation boundary. Prepare the policy for owner review; record only the authority actually granted. Do not generate, purchase or install audio, add runtime buses or settings, implement footsteps/music/voice, change accepted visuals or reopen completed character/ground/dressing scopes.
active_slice.completion_condition: One coherent audio direction and dynamic-range policy, with explicit provisional targets, cue/bus responsibilities, accessibility constraints and a finite next implementation boundary, is retained and reviewed; any needed owner choice is stated once. Close the policy slice when its deliverable is complete and select one named unfinished roadmap item.
active_slice.boundary: Documentation and reviewable audio-policy proposal only. Main, gameplay, runtime audio/assets/buses/settings, providers, voice implementation, accepted visual scopes, release/signing and Git publication stay outside this slice.
